brief.headline: Ask for a 15-day faster payment in exchange for ₹320 of our working cash; use Huhtamaki and UFLEX as scalable second sources to avoid single-vendor lock-in on laminates.

priceAsk.summary: Hold the line on price — our current rate sits at the top of the fair market band.
priceAsk.basis: Market research shows pharma/ORS sachet laminates ask ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), and our verdict is 'MARKET-FAIR (top of fair band)' — we're already paying a fair rate. The imported BOPET film benchmark is 171.60 ₹/kg, and conversion adds cost. No room to cut price further without data showing we overpay.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days after receipt to 15 days after receipt.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹320 of working cash for us.

brief.financialLeverage: Silk Polypack publishes no financial reports, so we can't see their revenue, profit, or how tight their cash is. Our ₹7775 annual spend is small, so we're not a major customer they'll bend over backwards for. That means we push gently: use the threat of a second source (Huhtamaki and UFLEX are both proven converters who can scale) to get faster payment terms and lock in today's fair price, rather than trying to squeeze a price cut we can't justify.

evidence.point: Our annual spend with Silk Polypack is tiny.
The open market for pharma/ORS sachet laminates asks a band we already sit in.
Our price verdict confirms we're paying a market-fair rate.
Switching to 15-day payment frees up working cash for FDC.
Imported BOPET film (the substrate) benchmarks much lower, but conversion and pharma specs add cost.

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter already supplying FDC in small volume — a proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets.

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant that makes both the film substrate AND does conversion — can second-source laminates at scale.

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Part of the global Constantia group, specialises in pharma blister and sachet laminates — strong second-source option (revenue ₹222.04 Cr, health score D 31/100, so check stability before RFQ).

risks: Silk Polypack's finances aren't public, so we can't tell if they're struggling or stable — watch for any supply hiccups and have Huhtamaki or UFLEX ready to step in.
Our ₹7775 spend is small, so they may say no to faster payment unless we hint at splitting volume with a second source.
The market ask is a reference range (₹205–305/kg), not a firm quote — if we push too hard on price without a lower quote in hand, they'll call our bluff.

Laminates are a specialised product for pharma sachets — switching suppliers mid-year means revalidation and lead time, so don't burn the bridge with Silk Polypack before Huhtamaki or UFLEX are qualified.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to move to 15-day payment to free up cash on both sides — in return, we want to lock in today's rate and explore a trial order with a second converter to de-risk our supply.
